focus: Secure, revocable final-balance links and customer-safe payment-status flow.
completed: Opaque 32-byte public tokens are stored only as SHA-256 hashes.
Customer payment page is token-gated, noindex, cache-disabled, and never returns customer PII.
Links have 14-day default expiry, 90-day maximum, rotation, cancellation, and reopen controls.
Stripe Checkout success/cancel URLs return to the token-gated payment page.
Stripe checkout.session.completed settles the final-balance request idempotently.
Admin Payments lists final-balance requests without token_hash exposure to browser clients.
Progress page shows customer-safe open, paid, expired, and cancelled payment states.
Secure payment placeholder slot uses generic artwork only; no customer invoice/card/media may be used.
manual_release_checks: Apply the Build 217 SQL migration after the prior payment tables are present.
Use Stripe test mode to create a checkout, complete it, and confirm webhook settlement once.
Verify invalid token and expired/cancelled links return no customer data.
Verify configured customer notification provider queues and delivers only after a controlled test.
Confirm the secure payment page is noindex and absent from sitemap.
boundary: This build does not process card data, send provider mail/SMS directly, or prove live Stripe/Cloudflare/Supabase deployment from the source package.
